text:
maria: Heads up — planning to enable redwood-3b-opt-v2 in the hosted model catalog tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Need fallback ordering and pinning strategy.

liam: Thanks. Can you post rollout config? We should do canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% and fallback to redwood-3b-opt-v1 then redwood-3b-int8.

maria: Proposed config:
```
rollout: redwood-3b-opt-v2
stages:
  - percent: 10
  - percent: 50
  - percent: 100
fallbacks:
  - redwood-3b-opt-v1
  - redwood-3b-int8
pinning: session-based, 24h
monitoring: latency, p99, error-rate, quality-evals
```
Any objections?

sahil: Looks good. Add a quick regression eval set (chat-regen-small) and enable auto-rollback if quality drops >4% or error-rate >0.5%.

anna: Also require no more than +15ms p99 over baseline. Ops: set capacity guardrail and pre-warm nodes.

deploy-bot: rollout plan saved by sahil at 1719001290. feature-flag: model/redwood-3b-opt-v2 enabled=false -> staged=true

liam: We should pin Dedicated customers to existing v1 until we validate. Add routing policy: tier=dedicated -> use v1 by default.

maria: Agreed. I'll update release notes and flag matrix. Quick checklist:
- update catalog entry
- add evals
- schedule change window
- update routing policy for Dedicated
- notify SRE/Support

sahil: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the rollback playbook with exact steps and command snippets.

maria: If issues during canary, immediate rollback command:
```
deploy rollback --model redwood-3b-opt-v2 --to redwood-3b-opt-v1
feature-flag set model/redwood-3b-opt-v2 staged=false
```
Keep me in loop on alerts.

anna: I'll set pager for the window and make sure oncall has playbook link.

liam: One more: specify KV-cache invalidation policy? The new model changes tokenization slightly.

maria: Good catch — add cache flush for prefix cache on rollout start. I'll add to playbook.

deploy-bot: scheduled change window 2024-06-22T02:00:00Z by maria. status: pending

sahil: All right, launching canary at 10% tomorrow. I'll post results in this thread.
